Address: Flat 1, 31 Juniper Mews, Cedarford, ZZ7 7ZZ

Good day Clara

Thank you for your patience. The landlord has replied about the kitchen extractor fan. They say there is a switch to the right-hand side of the hob that needs to be switched on for the fan to work.

Could you please check that switch and try the fan? Please let me know whether it now works. If it still does not turn on, tell me and I will ask the landlord about arranging a contractor visit.

Kind regards
Northbridge Lettings
input.reason: Landlord pointed to a wall switch beside the hob [event 008]. This is a cheap fix to try before any contractor visit or cost, so I am asking the tenant to test it first.
